title: Checkout
subtitle: Where should we send your finds?
emptyText: Add something you love, then come back to check out.

methods.codDescription: Pay in cash when your order arrives.
methods.codPaused: Cash on delivery is paused for: {{stores}}. Please pay online.
methods.cardDescription: Pay by card on Stripe's secure page. We never see your card details.

discountHelp: Checked by the store when you place your order; your total will show the saving.
note: Prices, stock and shipping are confirmed by Saloree when you place the order. Items from different stores become separate orders.
cannotPlace: Online payment isn't available yet, so this order can't be placed right now. Remove the products from {{stores}} to order the rest.
cardNote: You'll enter your card on Stripe's page. Your items are reserved while you pay.

pending.notice: Your payment was not completed. Your items are reserved for a short time.
pending.newOrderHint: The unpaid order is cancelled automatically after about 30 minutes.
pending.expired: That checkout can no longer be paid. Please place your order again from your bag.

overlay.title: Securing your order…
overlay.text: You will be redirected to our secure payment partner, Stripe. Please do not close this page.
overlay.livePlaced: Your order is placed and your items are reserved. Connecting to Stripe…
overlay.liveConnected: Connected to Stripe. Opening the payment page…

countryPick: Choose your country from the list.
phoneHint: Include your country code, for example +93.
cardHelp: You will pay on Stripe's secure page.
discountAdded: {{code}} will be checked when you place your order.
unavailable: Some items in your bag are no longer available and were left out.
separateOrders: Items from {{stores}} become separate orders, one per store.
fillToContinue: Fill in your delivery details to continue.

express.note: You're buying only this item. Your bag stays as it is.
express.unavailableTitle: This product is no longer available
express.unavailableText: It may be sold out or no longer for sale. Your bag has not changed.
